_comment: A mode adds a prompt block (prompts/mode.<id>.md) to the tutor system prompt. opening = 'persona' speaks the persona's own opening line with no model call; 'instruction' sends openingInstruction as the first user turn so the model starts (the 2025 app's initiatingInstruction). usesWordlist = the app passes {{wordHints}} drawn from wordlists/<lang>/common-1000.csv within the level's vocabulary band. In a usesWordlist mode the app picks the first word and fills {{firstWord}}; if the reply doesn't contain it, the app speaks strings.wordLabOpening instead.

modes.label: Story time
modes.blurb: A tiny story, then one question.
modes.openingInstruction: Begin now: tell the first story and ask the question.

modes.label: Word lab
modes.blurb: One word at a time, harder as you go.
modes.openingInstruction: Begin now with the word {{firstWord}}: say it, then ask whether the learner knows what it means.
